title: Gesta principum Polonorum; commonly Kronika polska in Polish
description: Position 91 in the owner-supplied audited revision. Attribution: Anonymous; traditionally called Gallus Anonymus. Date: Composed approximately 1112–1116.. Form: Chronicle with rhetorical and verse elements; three-book work.. Dynastic narrative becomes a shaped account of political legitimacy rather than a neutral record. Its importance to the beginnings of literature associated with Poland warrants a carefully bounded place. The author remains anonymous, and neither the conventional name nor a modern translated title establishes an original national identity.
